# Theater counts: Spider‑Man swings into 4,487 theaters to kick off its run
Once again, last weekend’s box office was ruled by Christopher Nolan’s [_The Odyssey_](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Odyssey-The-(2026)), which powered to an epic $90.02 million in its sophomore frame to lift its domestic tally to $289.39 million.

# Weekend projections: Fantastic hold for The Odyssey sets up monster run
Two records Universal is touting this morning are that _The Odyssey_ will have the second-best second weekend for an R-rated film, behind only [_Deadpool & Wolverine_](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Deadpool-and-Wolverine-(2024)#domestic), and it’ll have the third-best hold for a movie that opened to over $100 million, behind [_Wicked_](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Wicked-(2024)#domestic) (a Thanksgiving-boosted 28%) and [_Top Gun: Maverick_](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Top-Gun-Maverick-(2022)#domestic) (29%, despite coming off a Memorial Day Weekend opening).

# Theater counts: Minions storm in with 4,243-theater bow
Last weekend, [_Toy Story 5_](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Toy-Story-5-(2026)) held firm in first place, pulling in just over $70 million in its sophomore frame and lifting its 10‑day total to $298.07 million.

# Theater counts: Toy Story swats away Supergirl and holds onto the crown as the widest release
[_Toy Story 5_](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Toy-Story-5-(2026)) blasted into theaters last weekend, scoring a franchise‑best $160 million over the three‑day frame and climbing to a six‑day haul of $216 million.

Rounding out the top five widest movies this weekend is current chart-topper, _Toy Story 5_, holding its massive 4,425‑theater footprint and once again claiming the crown as the frame’s widest release. [_Disclosure Day_](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Disclosure-Day-(2026)) slides from 3,824 locations last weekend to 3,357, while $222 million earner [_Obsession_](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Obsession-(2026)) ranks fourth, playing in 2,965 venues.
